Name: My name is Catbug - what's yours
Author: jkaraffa
Description:
A very simple mod to add Catbug to your game. Just replace teh cat.xnb and ta daaaa! Everything is oooookay!

To locate the cat.xnb go to

Program Files --> Steam --> Steam Apps --> common --> Stardew Valley --> Content --> Animals

Phew, we're having soft tacos later.

REBECCAAAA!

<3

If you like this and want more Catbug stuff let me know on twitter, @goodbyehalcyone! Tweet me some pics of your Catbug, or let me know if you have any issues.

Thank you!

Goodbye Halcyone
